observations: Edition mismatch: cover cites 2025 California codes, foundation notes cite CBC 2022 / ACI 318-19 / TMS 402/602, but calcs use MSJC-13 with ASCE 7-10 combinations, NDS-2015 (header), NDS 2018 (ledger), ACI318-14 and ASCE 7-16.
Soil bearing: drawings require 1500 psf minimum; footing calc uses qallow_Gross = 3.5 ksf (qmax = 2.084 ksf would exceed 1.5 ksf).
Footing geometry/reinforcement: section F1- 18"X10" analysed with Ly = 1.6 ft (19.2 in) and No.4 bars at 6.0 in c/c bottom vs schedule 18"W x 10"D with (3) #4 top and bottom long. & #4 @18" trans.
CMU reinforcement: calc No.5 bars at 8 in centers (As = 0.46 in2/ft) and (2) No. 4 horizontal at 8 in vs drawings #5 @ 32" O.C. max and #4 bond beam at top only.
CMU lateral loads look like placeholders: W = 18 psf, Wp = 18 psf, Eadd = 40 psf additional seismic; DLabove = 50 lb/ft, LLabove = 60 lb/ft.

Ledger: calc uses 0.50 in A307 bolts, lm = 6.00 in, DL = 15 plf / LL = 20 plf; drawings specify 5/8" Ø anchor bolts @ 24" with 5" min embed into grouted CMU. Lateral W = 150 plf and Eh = 50 plf entered but bolt check uses Vh_bolt = 0 lb (Load combination 3 only). V'r value not printed.
Header 2-2X10 is called 'NON LOAD BEARING HDR' on plans but designed for 30 plf D + 20 plf L over 17 ft (δb_s1 = 0.337 in).
Roof joists 2x10 @ 24" O.C. (DFL#2) shown on plans have no calculation in the package; footing line loads (FDz1 = 1.5 kips, FLz1 = 1.3 kips per ft) are not traced to the ledger/CMU loads.
extractionNotes: Values copied verbatim from the text dump (no recalculation). Markdown escape backslashes in the dump were removed (e.g. 'Vw\_max' -> 'Vw_max', 'Fc\*' -> 'Fc*'). Keys are the printed Tedds symbols; where a symbol repeats on a sheet the key carries the printed heading context in [brackets] and '#n' for further repeats. 'labels' maps keys to the printed description. Inputs = plain printed values in input blocks; results = computed values (printed with a formula), ratios, and values printed in analysis/design blocks; results.checks = PASS/FAIL lines as printed.
